// ==== koine/generated/sales/Order.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.generated.sales;

public final class Order {
    private final OrderId id;
    private OrderStatus status;
    private final boolean paid;

    /**
     * Creates a validated Order, enforcing its invariants.
     */
    public Order(OrderId id) {
        this.id = id;
        this.status = OrderStatus.Draft;
        this.paid = false;
    }

    public OrderId id() {
        return this.id;
    }

    public OrderStatus status() {
        return this.status;
    }

    public boolean paid() {
        return this.paid;
    }

    /**
     * Places a draft order. The precondition already states the only legal source.
     */
    public void place() {
        if (!(java.util.Objects.equals(this.status, OrderStatus.Draft))) {
            throw new koine.runtime.DomainException("only a draft order can be placed");
        }
        this.status = OrderStatus.Placed;
    }

    /**
     * Cancels an order — legal from two different source states.
     */
    public void cancel() {
        if (!java.util.Objects.equals(this.status, OrderStatus.Draft) && !java.util.Objects.equals(this.status, OrderStatus.Placed)) {
            throw new koine.runtime.DomainException("illegal transition of status to Cancelled");
        }
        this.status = OrderStatus.Cancelled;
    }

    /**
     * Completes an order — legal only from InKitchen, and only when paid.
     */
    public void complete() {
        if (!(java.util.Objects.equals(this.status, OrderStatus.InKitchen) && (this.paid))) {
            throw new koine.runtime.DomainException("illegal transition of status to Completed");
        }
        this.status = OrderStatus.Completed;
    }

    @Override
    public boolean equals(Object o) {
        if (this == o) {
            return true;
        }
        if (!(o instanceof Order other)) {
            return false;
        }
        return java.util.Objects.equals(this.id, other.id);
    }

    @Override
    public int hashCode() {
        return java.util.Objects.hashCode(this.id);
    }
}

// ==== koine/generated/sales/OrderStatus.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.generated.sales;

/**
 * The lifecycle state of an order; the `states` machine below fixes the legal transitions.
 */
public enum OrderStatus {
    Draft,
    Placed,
    InKitchen,
    Completed,
    Cancelled
}

// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * Thrown when a domain invariant is violated. Unchecked ({@code RuntimeException}) so generated
 * value objects, entities, and aggregates can guard their invariants without checked-exception
 * ceremony — the Java analogue of the C# emitter's DomainInvariantViolationException.
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public class DomainException extends RuntimeException {
    public DomainException(String message) {
        super(message);
    }
}

// ==== koine/runtime/Range.java ====
// <auto-generated/>
package koine.runtime;

/**
 * A closed interval {@code [start, end]} over a comparable type — the Java analogue of the Rust
 * runtime's {@code Range}. The {@code start()}/{@code end()} accessors are the record's own; the
 * caller is responsible for {@code start <= end} (a domain invariant).
 *
 * <p>Generated by Koine — do not edit by hand.</p>
 */
public record Range<T extends Comparable<? super T>>(T start, T end) {
    /** True when {@code value} lies within the closed interval {@code [start, end]}. */
    public boolean contains(T value) {
        return start.compareTo(value) <= 0 && value.compareTo(end) <= 0;
    }

    /** True when this interval and {@code other} share at least one point. */
    public boolean overlaps(Range<T> other) {
        return start.compareTo(other.end) <= 0 && other.start.compareTo(end) <= 0;
    }
}
